title: Deploying retail AI to scale personalisation and customer insight
summary: This article discusses how retailers are deploying AI infrastructure to move beyond static customer interaction patterns and broad demographic segmentation toward real-time personalization systems with dynamic data pipelines capable of modifying user experiences during live sessions.
problem_solved: Solves the problem of static, demographics-based customer segmentation that fails to meet modern conversion targets in retail environments.
why_valuable: Enables retailers to deliver personalized experiences in real-time during live sessions, significantly improving conversion rates compared to traditional static approaches.
